name: dembrandt
description: Extract complete design systems from any website URL — colors (primary, secondary, CSS variables), typography (font families, sizes, weights), spacing, borders, shadows, UI component patterns, breakpoints, logos, and favicons. Uses Playwright to render sites like a human user, bypasses bot detection, and outputs structured design tokens as JSON or W3C DTCG format. Perfect for competitor analysis, design audits, documentation, and building or benchmarking design systems.

install_steps: Run: npm install -g dembrandt   — global install
Or use via npx: npx dembrandt <url>   — no install needed
Then: sc dembrandt analyze <url>   — extract design tokens

commands.description: Extract design tokens from a website URL

args.name: dtcg
args.description: Export tokens in W3C Design Tokens format

args.name: save-output
args.description: Save results as JSON file for audits and documentation

args.name: browser
args.description: Browser engine to use (default: chromium, use firefox for bot-protected sites)

args.name: slow
args.description: Slow mode for reliable extraction on JS-heavy SPAs
